meta_tool_title: Rusticker: make WhatsApp stickers in your browser
meta_tool_description: Cut a whole sticker sheet into a WhatsApp-ready pack. Everything happens in your browser; your images are never uploaded.
meta_how_to_use_description: Step by step: prepare your image, cut out the stickers, and import the pack into WhatsApp.
meta_about_description: Rusticker processes your images on your own device. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account or tracking, and the code is open source.
page_how_to_use_intro: In a few steps, a single image with many stickers becomes a pack ready for WhatsApp.
page_how_to_use_step_prepare: Prepare an image with all your stickers on a background of one uniform color, such as chroma-key green, with a little space between them.
page_how_to_use_step_open: Open Rusticker and add the image: drag the file in, choose it from your device, or paste it with Ctrl+V.
page_how_to_use_step_adjust: Check the detected stickers. If needed, pick the background color with the eyedropper and adjust the tolerance.
page_how_to_use_step_download: Remove any stickers you do not want, choose the pack icon, and download the .zip file.
page_how_to_use_step_import: On your phone, open the .zip with a sticker-pack importer app and add the pack to WhatsApp.
page_how_to_use_import_note: Each WhatsApp pack needs 3 to 30 stickers. If you have more than 30, Rusticker splits them into several packs.
page_about_intro: Rusticker cuts a whole sticker sheet into a WhatsApp-ready pack, right in your browser.
page_about_privacy_body: All image processing happens locally, on your device. Your images are never uploaded to any server.
page_about_no_account_body: There is no account, no sign-up, and no tracking. The site only remembers the language you choose, and only in your browser.
page_about_open_source_body: Rusticker is an open-source project, released under the MIT license.
design_intro: Development-only page: every design-system component and variant, in the light and dark themes.
design_overlays_note: Dialogs, menus, tooltips and toasts use the page theme. Switch it here:

meta_history_description: Review local summaries of images processed with Rusticker.
history_privacy_explanation: If enabled, Rusticker saves the completion date, image dimensions, background color, tolerance, and sticker count on this device. It may also save a private SHA-256 fingerprint to recognize the exact same file. Fingerprints are never shown or sent anywhere. History keeps at most 50 runs for up to 90 days; your browser can remove it sooner.
history_no_images_retained: Source images, file names, sticker pixels, and exported packs are never saved. History is best-effort browser storage and may be removed by your browser.
history_reselect_notice: History entries are summaries only. To process or export again, select the original image on the tool page.
history_disable_prompt: New runs will no longer be saved. Choose whether to keep or delete the summaries already stored on this device.
history_storage_unavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Processing and export still work, but history cannot be read or saved.
history_save_unavailable: This run could not be added to history. Your processing result is still available.
history_empty: No processing runs have been saved yet.
history_duplicate_notice: This exact file had been processed before.
history_clear_confirm_body: This permanently deletes all Rusticker history summaries and local fingerprints from this browser.
export_error_webp_unsupported: This browser can't create WEBP stickers. Try Chrome, Edge, or Firefox.
export_error_failed: Couldn't create the pack. Please try again.
